notes.title: Monthly Update May 29
notes.content:
In this update, I’ve made several gameplay adjustments, including improved alert dialogs and more detailed information for objects.

One key change in this build is the use of uncompressed audio for the main theme music. This decision was made to address delays that were occurring with compressed formats. While this makes the download slightly larger, the benefit is smoother sound playback and reduced processing demand — a worthwhile trade-off.

Additionally, I’ve extended the duration of certain potion effects and enhanced the audio effects throughout the game. 

Enjoy ;)

- enhanced the audio effects throughout the game

notes.title: Minor Update May 10
notes.content:
This update should be the final one needed to address the major issues reported since launch. Going forward, updates will likely be less frequent—perhaps once a month. We’ve made improvements to the training mode and resolved several minor bugs, particularly related to weapon quick-swapping and handling crystals and diamonds more easily.

With this build, I’m hoping things are stable enough to begin focusing more on gameplay polish and visual details. If you run into anything, feel free to reach out—every suggestion is appreciated! I’m excited to see how players experience the later parts of the game. 😉

Enjoy!

notes.title: UI Update May 5
notes.content:
This update includes some adjustments to the recent UI scaling improvements for larger monitors. We’ve also introduced two new features:

•	L1/L2 Functionality: Pressing L1 or L2 will now launch grenades if you have any available. If not, these buttons will function as the regular weapon controls (R1/R2).

•	Inventory Quick-Swap: Pressing up/down on the D-pad will now quickly cycle between inventory items.

If you notice any glitches, please let us know! ;)
